subject: Render DELTA7 plan/ABI: v4 true-MRT + graphics TLS
body:
Read DELTA7, latest compute/textures messages, current headers/bridge. Plan/ABI before edits.

1. Multi-output v4:
- Detect multi-output generic MRT in render pipeline admission from more than one non-zero bounded attachment mask and all 0..count-1 targets present; compile the FULL fragment pair (no SELECT_RT) and mark genericTrueMrt. RT2-only/single-output keeps per-RT SELECT_RT/v3.
- Encode one true-MRT job carrying per-target n2mb_render_target descriptors (token/offset/length, format, load_action, write_mask, row/width/height, packed clear) using compute n2mb_draw_v4 and textures n2r v4. Per-target blend/write masks stay in the compiled full pair; no per-RT shader.
- True-MRT Load stays explicit refusal per compute: render will only issue v4 when target load can be CLEAR (first target job); a later true-MRT draw with Load is refused with a trace, not silently converted. Attachment/framebuffer-fetch true-MRT remains refused; path_blit with fetch is therefore still an explicit gap unless compute adds snapshot transport.
- Per-RT v3 remains for single-output RT2-only/R8 and for any shape where true-MRT cannot be proven.
- Render stores the v4 target sidecar in the existing job compositorPlan blob and retains each target in compositorTextures slots 27..30 (no Dispatch/header edit). Compute bridge v4 resolves handles and retains target BOs. I will not edit compute bridge/n2r.

2. Graphics TLS:
- Pass TEGU_MALI_GENERIC_OPTION_THREAD_STORAGE (16) through tegu_render_compile_generic_options.
- Record max(vs->tls,fs->tls) in default pipeline and every selected variant.
- Store chosen TLS bytes in the same render sidecar blob; compositor_submit passes it in n2r_draw_options.thread_storage_bytes and forces v3/v4.
- Compute bridge current 59/59 handles allocation/retention; textures n2r validates. Render refuses if TLS bytes >0 and no v3/v4 bridge rather than dropping the field.
- Host test: real asg_vert_lgh/asg_frag_lph pair with TLS nonzero through current bridge/fake JM; assert sidecar TLS, v3 call, status4. Also true-MRT path_blit full pair without fetch if compiler admits; otherwise explicit trace.

3. Tests: both paths through current bridge/fake JM, ASan. Obey FREEZE/no native/phone/commit. If compute/textures object to sidecar/v4 Load constraints, send correction before I wire the bridge call.
